subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — persist widget state via a setState bridge capability

question: Should dashboard widget write-back require SQLite/plugin-KV storage and full bridge concurrency wiring before merge, or may maintainers explicitly accept the JSON state path and current sandbox write-back contract as an exception?
rationale: This PR changes persistent runtime storage and the iframe-to-parent trust boundary, which automation cannot approve without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Require redesign before merge
options.body: Keep the feature direction but require approved SQLite/plugin-KV storage, `expectedVersion` bridge plumbing, live proof, and security review before this lands.

options.title: Approve explicit exception
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can intentionally accept the per-widget JSON state path and current bridge contract as product debt for this dashboard layer.

options.title: Pause behind the stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the predecessor custom-widget host stack lands or is rejected, then re-review write-back against a stable base.

recommendation.title: Require redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction but require approved SQLite/plugin-KV storage, `expectedVersion` bridge plumbing, live proof, and security review before this lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main owner signal for the bundled plugin-tab and adjacent plugin storage patterns this PR extends.
